primitives.note: Last Rites arms the next basic attack within 5s with bonus physical damage, 50 bonus range, and a self-heal
Last Rites resets Yorick's basic attack timer on cast
Touch of the Maiden arms Yorick's next basic attack with bonus magic damage equal to a % of target max health (capped at 30)
Mourning Mist deals its splash magic damage on a fixed 0.25s cast + travel time, on cooldown
Mourning Mist damage scales as % of target's current max health; Touch of the Maiden's bonus damage is also a % of target max health
Cursed mark applies an armor-shred (13-25% of target's armor) for its duration, increasing damage taken from all sources including autos
Mist Walkers (raised from graves via Q's Awakening or E's Cursed mark) and the Maiden of the Mist (from R) are separate entities that auto-attack the target for extra damage
R has a distinct summon phase and an optional later recast to release the Maiden; the recast has no damage benefit against a solo stationary target
Mana costs (20/70/50-70/100) could matter for how often E and R-adjacent casts happen inside 15s, though Q is cheap enough to spam on cooldown

needsBespoke.why: Yorick's damage output against a single always-alive dummy depends heavily on the grave/Mist Walker economy: graves are raised by Last Rites hitting an enemy champion (the dummy), consumed by Awakening or E's Cursed mark into Mist Walkers, and Mist Walkers (from passive) share a 4-unit cap with R's ghouls near the Maiden. None of the closed primitives model this shared cap, the rate at which a Cursed mark continually raises walkers from a fixed number of graves, or how many graves a single non-dying target actually generates over repeated Last Rites hits. In addition, Q's self-heal based on missing health has no matching primitive (heal/shield is not one of the listed categories), which matters for the survival fight since Yorick heals off his own attacks.

unsettled.question: Does each Last Rites empowered attack that lands on the dummy raise a new grave, or does a grave only spawn once total against a target that never dies (since the note about '1 grave even if it kills them' implies dedupe against the same enemy)?
options: Every Last Rites hit on the dummy raises a fresh grave (up to the 4-grave cap, replacing the furthest)
Only the first Last Rites hit on the dummy raises a grave; subsequent hits on the same still-alive target raise none
quotes: Whenever '''Yorick''' uses ''{{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}}'' to score the killing blow on any enemy or damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, he raises a ''grave''
Damaging a large monster or champion with {{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}} will only spawn 1 grave, even if it kills them.

unsettled.question: While a target is Cursed (from E), does the 'continually raises a Mist Walker from each nearby grave' effect spawn one walker per grave once, or does it repeat/tick for the full 4-second mark duration (and if so, at what rate)?
options: One-time consumption of all nearby graves into walkers when the curse is applied
Repeated raising at some tick rate for the full 4s Cursed duration, potentially exceeding available graves as they regenerate
quotes: continually raises a {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} from each nearby ''grave'', up to a maximum of 4

unsettled.question: Do the Mist Walkers raised passively/via E share the same 4-unit active cap with the Mist Walkers/ghouls summoned by R near the Maiden, or are these two pools counted and capped independently?
options: Single shared cap of 4 total Mist Walkers across both the passive pool and R's summons
R's initial ghouls near the Maiden are a separate pool from the passive's 4-cap near Yorick
quotes: Up to 4 {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} can be active at once near '''Yorick''' or near '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|The Maiden|nolink=true}}''', with the nearest one always being replaced by the newest upon raising one over the limit.

unsettled.question: Does Touch of the Maiden's on-hit bonus magic damage count as a basic attack's on-hit portion for the purposes of item on-hit effects, or as a separate spell-like proc?
options: It is treated as on-hit damage bundled into the attack (triggers on-hit item effects normally)
It is a distinct proc that does not interact with on-hit item effects the way a normal attack does
quotes: '''Yorick's''' next basic attack will consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} by a portion of the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}.

proposal: Cast R (Eulogy of the Isles) at the very start of the fight to summon the Maiden of the Mist and her Mist Walkers next to the dummy; because R's cooldown only starts after Yorick or the Maiden dies, this is effectively a one-time, fight-long pet investment and should never be recast to release her (releasing would stop her attacking the dummy).

Cast E (Mourning Mist) on the dummy as soon as it lands after R's summon delay, applying the max-health-based magic damage, the armor shred, and the Cursed mark so Mist Walkers leap onto and focus the target.

Weave Q (Last Rites) on cooldown: cast it, then land the empowered basic attack immediately (it resets the attack timer, so follow with a normal auto-attack right after) to maximize both the Q bonus damage and total auto-attack count.
Use Touch of the Maiden's empowered basic attack as soon as it becomes available (whenever the Maiden lands an attack marking the target), prioritizing it over a plain auto-attack.
Recast E every time it comes off cooldown to refresh the Cursed mark (re-applying armor shred and raising more Mist Walkers from any available graves) and deal its repeatable max-health damage.
Cast Awakening (Q's alternate action) whenever at least 3 graves are available and Last Rites is on cooldown, to add more Mist Walkers to the fight without giving up a Last Rites cast.
Auto-attack continuously between ability casts; do not use W (Dark Procession) since it deals no meaningful damage and its knockback/terrain is a CC effect that is ignored in this fight.
questions: Against a single stationary dummy target, how many graves actually accumulate over 15s (see unsettled grave-spawn question), since that caps how much of the kit's pet damage (Mist Walkers) is realizable?
Does Awakening have its own cast time/animation that would delay the Q+auto-attack weave, or is it effectively free to slot in between other actions?

Do the Maiden and her initial Mist Walkers auto-attack the target autonomously and continuously without any player input needed, and at what effective attack speed/AD (per the bin's byLevel/ratio values)?
Is Yorick's mana pool at the assumed level/items sufficient to cast E on cooldown for the full 15s alongside Q, or does resource-budget force skipping some E casts?
